description: This Rust source file defines structures, constants, and functions for handling virtio input device configuration, including parsing JSON configurations, managing bitmaps, and serializing/deserializing device settings.

classes.name: VirtioInputBitmap
classes.description: A bitmap used to represent supported input events and properties for virtio input devices.

classes.name: VirtioInputConfig
classes.description: Configuration structure for a virtio input device, including methods for JSON parsing, raw data setting, and serialization.

classes.name: InputConfigFile
classes.description: Data structure representing the JSON configuration file for input devices.

classes.name: InputConfigFileEvent
classes.description: Represents individual event configurations within the input device JSON config.

classes.name: InputConfigFileAbsInfo
classes.description: Represents absolute axis information in the input device JSON configuration.

methods.name: trim_to_event_size_multiple
methods.description: Calculates the largest multiple of VIRTIO_INPUT_EVENT_SIZE less than or equal to the given value.

methods.name: VirtioInputBitmap::new
methods.description: Creates a new bitmap initialized to zero.

methods.name: VirtioInputBitmap::set
methods.description: Sets a bit at the specified index in the bitmap.

methods.name: VirtioInputBitmap::min_size
methods.description: Returns the minimum size needed to hold all set bits.

methods.name: VirtioInputConfig::from_json
methods.description: Creates a VirtioInputConfig instance from a JSON string.

methods.name: VirtioInputConfig::set_raw
methods.description: Sets raw configuration data at a specified offset.

methods.name: VirtioInputConfig::get_raw
methods.description: Serializes the configuration into a byte vector.
